name: McCoy Creek
places: St. Charles Community College Technical Campus Wentzville
SSM Health St. Joseph Hospital - Wentzville
about: McCoy Creek drains about 33 square miles, 95% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 720 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 440 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are McCoy Creek, Dry Branch, Crossroads Creek and Enon Branch. St. Charles County communities here include Wentzville, Flint Hill, Foristell and Josephville. Downstream, its water passes through the Lower Big Creek watershed, then flows into the Cuivre River, which empties into the Mississippi River.
